formulaBlock.normalization: ID-2: 'Aqua/Water' one entry; no split entries; 34 normalized entries; normalized positions. PEG-40 Hydrogenated Castor Oil is listed twice (@26 and @30); this is a repeated full entry, not a split synonym, so both positions are kept and the repeat is recorded as a source artifact (immaterial: both after the E3 point, excluded from weight).

cleansingStrength.rationale: low by C6: no strong anionic; the earliest prominent cleansing surfactant is the C3b mild anionic Sodium Methyl 2-Sulfolaurate @2, with prominent amphoteric co-surfactants Cocamidopropyl Hydroxysultaine @3 and Sodium Lauroamphoacetate @6; further mild anionics Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate @4, Sodium Lauryl Sulfoacetate @5, Sodium Methyl Cocoyl Taurate @7, Disodium 2-Sulfolaurate @10. C3b: a sulfolaurate is the earliest prominent cleansing surfactant, so confidence is at most moderate and the neighbor is the next stronger value, moderate.

conditioningLevel.rationale: low: cleansing-led architecture; the only conditioning polymer is Polyquaternium-22 @15 after the E3 point; Hydrolyzed Wheat Protein @24 late; humectants Glycerin @8, Sodium PCA @13; no silicone, lipid or pearlizer. Counter-signal: polymer + protein + humectants are several light routes that could read as moderate; neighbor moderate.

wLineRecord.note: The E3 marker @11 is the earliest plausible candidate, so the W-line equals the cap; no fallback code. No payload_lipid in the formula.

weightPotential.counterevidence: Two deposition families (cationic polymer, protein) are present, and the mild C6 chassis offers little reset.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: The only depositing routes are one light cationic polymer (@15) and a hydrolyzed protein (@24), both after the fragrance and the first preservatives; no silicone, no lipid, no film former.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: W2: both families are late/trace (after the E3 point and after preservatives @17, @19, @21) and of low persistence (light polymer, hydrolyzed protein), so their combined residue is plausibly below noticeable even with weak reset; moderate stays the realistic neighbor.
weightPotential.rationale: low: late light polymer plus late protein, W2 reason named (6.6, W2).

focusPrimary.counterSignal: Apigenin @31, Oleanolic Acid @32, Biotinoyl Tripeptide-1 @33 are a hair-loss-type complex and never a focus route (F5).
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Blind pass: claim direction null; light low-weight formula compatible with volume or general; provisional general.
